annotations.title: Check whether a product is in scope of the CRA

description: Checks whether the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA, Regulation (EU) 2024/2847) applies to a product, i.e. whether it is in scope, and its CRA product class: default, important class I or II (for example browsers, password managers, VPNs, operating systems, routers, smart home security devices, firewalls, hypervisors) or critical (for example smartcards, smart meter gateways). For software, mobile and desktop apps, firmware, IoT and other hardware, components, open-source projects and SaaS. Start with answers {}; each call returns the next question to ask the user, or, once all are answered, the result: in scope / outside scope / needs a closer reading, the provisional class and the cited articles (Art. 2, 3, 7, Annex III/IV). Does not cover other laws (NIS2, GDPR, AI Act); not a conformity assessment or legal advice.

answers.description: Answers so far about the product (software, app, firmware, hardware or IoT device): question id -> option id, from the questions returned earlier or listed by cra_scope_questions. Start with {} to get the first question.
